title: Stored insight builds
description: One GLOBAL census observation, with no product, team or permission scope. The producer stamps built_at on each completed cadence build so unchanged views and watermark do not reuse an older publication. The artifact row's created_at remains the authoritative publication time and serving-age bound. folded_after is a separate pre-fold decision watermark, not the observation or publication time. Core validates each view and owns freshness checks; callers apply their authorization after serving.

built_at.description: When this cadence observation completed. The producer supplies a fresh value on each build, including unchanged or returning view content. Not the database publication time or the decision watermark.

folded_after.description: The newest qualifying actor statement's database recording time sampled before folding; null when none existed. Qualifying statements have an actor other than the canonical machine: namespace, conservatively including legacy or unknown actor spellings without granting them human authority.
folded_after.$comment: Null carries the semantics of the watermark, not a missing value; the artifact row's created_at is the publication moment.

views.description: The census view models by view name (findings-rollup, coverage, remediation-index, findings-trend, ...). Every value is the model that view's build would return for an unscoped read.
